## Requirements (R-2.12.2 — §8.4 C0/Stage-1 slice)

The §8.4 Stage-1 assignment lands: the `PluginManifest/1` schema (a data
document — inventory only, no code), `ContractRef` (the only dependency
form — X1), `ContractVersionPolicy` (supported versions + sunsets +
additive-only), `check_compatibility` inside `resolve` (ranges ∩
supported − sunset, `ContractIncompatible{ref, offered_range,
supported_range, sunset?}`), `tier`/`depends_on` declarations on the
Stage-1 classes and plugin manifests, the spec-DAG check as a
readiness-report tool (X2: `tier_violations = []`, `cycles = []`), the
module-graph lint (X1 for first-party in-process variants), the
`plugin_abi/1` schema in the kernel's schema export (envelope
`{protocol_version, schema_hash, seq, payload}`, closed verbs/callbacks/
verdicts), `placement` on registrations, and the golden manifest corpus.

Explicitly NOT this ticket (§8.4 build-stage table): the variant host /
subprocess execution, host callbacks + V1–V6 enforcement, `requests →
Permission + ContainmentPolicy` lowering, conformance kit + reach suite,
M19, third-party publish/install, foreign import/export, attestation-gated
admission, `remote`/`container`/`component_model` placement execution,
evolution-service plugins, any Hosting ABI reference (AC-12 forbids it).

## Test matrix (planned)

| requirement | check |
|---|---|
| PluginManifest/1 codec | round-trip; unknown non-`ext` key fails; inline body/closure member fails; `path_or_locator` escaping the package root fails; `summary` ≤ `external` enforced |
| AC-1 inventory | corpus of valid + failing manifests; strict codec ≡ naive checker verdicts byte-identical |
| AC-2 compat-before-load | `check_compatibility` inside the extension-candidate resolve; `ContractIncompatible{…, sunset?}`; sunset refusal with dated reason; `negotiate_version` picks highest common; refusal occurs before any launchable artifact is touched (pure resolve — no spawn exists at Stage 1) |
| ContractRef/ContractVersionPolicy | codec round-trips; additive-only flag; sunset `date \| stage` bounds |
| tier/depends_on | `ClassRecord.depends_on: [ContractRef]` + `tier`; manifest `tier`/`depends_on`; upward edge detected |
| spec-DAG check (AC-8) | parses §4.4 tables of `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` as data; reports `tier_violations=[]`, `cycles=[]`; negative fixtures catch an upward edge and a cycle |
| module-graph lint (AC-8/X1) | first-party in-process variant modules import only contract interfaces + public record types; negative fixture caught |
| plugin_abi/1 (AC-12) | schema export emitted to `schema/plugin-abi-1.schema.json` (drift-checked); envelope members; no Hosting ABI/`OpaqueProcess` reference in the schema or the manifest corpus |
| placement | `placement_preference` = `Placement::for_executable`; `component_model`/`remote`/`container`/`host_unconfined` → `LocalityInadmissible` at Stage-1 admission; registration mapping |
| `resolve` sunset guard | `RegistryStore::resolve(mode=execute)` refuses a plugin whose `requires` miss the policy set (past-sunset = dated reason) |
| admissions | `UnknownRecordKind`, `UnpinnedInSealedForm`, `RequestsExceedCap{authority_cap}`, `SourceNotAllowed`, `AttestationRequired` typed refusals |

## Implementation notes

- **`hh-plugin` (new crate)** — `contract.rs` (`ContractRef`,
  `ContractRefKind{contract,record_kind,schema,service}`, `VersionRange`,
  `ContractVersionPolicy`, `SunsetBound`, `EvalPoint`,
  `ContractIncompatible{ref,offered_range,supported_range,sunset?}`,
  `check_compatibility`, `negotiate_version` = highest common,
  `range_covers`, `version_cmp`, `kernel_contract_policies`,
  `contract_defining_tier`); `dag.rs` (`parse_spec_tables` over the §4.4
  markdown tables as data, `spec_dag_check`, `ClassDagInput`/`PluginDagInput`,
  `SpecDagReport{tier_violations,cycles,unknown_refs,parse_errors}` — the
  ticket's exact field names); `lint.rs` (`lint_source` — `use`-root
  allowlist, sibling-`variants` reach, `mod` decls, `unsafe`; `lint_crates`
  walker over `crates/*/src/variants/**`); `corpus.rs` (checker-agnostic
  golden-corpus driver: `bytes → Result<id, kind>` + `.expect` pins);
  `bin/plugin_check.rs` (`hh-plugin-check spec-dag|module-lint`).
- **`hh-embed-schema::plugin_abi`** — `plugin_abi/1`: envelope
  `{protocol_version,schema_hash,seq,payload}` + verb payloads
  (`Bind/Invoke/Unload/Park/Checkpoint`…) and closed sums (`GuardVerdict`,
  `HostCallback`, `BindFailure`, `TriState`, `TypedFailure`);
  `export_plugin_abi_schema()` → `schema/plugin-abi-1.schema.json` via
  `hh-codegen`; `schema_hash()` = `idp/1` `ContentAddress` over the canonical
  bytes (CC1 — the one canonicalizer). No Hosting-ABI/`OpaqueProcess`
  reference anywhere in the schema (AC-12/T-LCD-06).
- **`hh-registry::extension::plugin`** — `PluginManifest/1` strict codec
  (`manifest_from_json`/`to_json`/`from_bytes`; unknown non-`ext` member →
  `UnknownRecordKind`; non-object → `SchemaViolation`), `ManifestError` typed
  sum, `admit_plugin` inside `register`'s `Extension` arm (namespace →
  locality → tier → `check_compatibility` → `requests ⊆ requests_cap`),
  `execute_mode_compat_check` inside `resolve(mode = execute)` — sunset
  catches between admission and execute refuse with the dated bound.
  `identity.namespace`, `requires.{hir_dialect,registry_dialect,plugin_abi}`
  ranges materialise as `ContractRef`s on the `…/1` contract ids (X1 — one
  dependency form). Pin rules: string `path_or_locator` = package-relative
  (absolute/`..`/`:`/empty → `SchemaViolation`), object = pinned
  `SourceLocator` else `UnpinnedInSealedForm`; `code_pointer` =
  `ContentAddress` object only; `declaration` members named
  `body`/`content`/`closure`/`code` refused (declarations name records,
  never carry them — AC-1).
- **`ClassRecord.depends_on: Vec<ContractRef>`** — absent-when-empty in the
  canonical encoding, so every pre-S1.27 class record's canonical bytes (and
  `version_id`) are unchanged (CC8).
- **`RegistryPolicy.contract_version_policies`** — layered-first precedence
  over `kernel_contract_policies()` + generated `record_kind:*` rows; encodes
  only when non-empty (old policy bytes unchanged, CC8).
- **`range_covers`/`version_cmp` consolidation** — `hh_registry::store`'s
  private copies are delegates to `hh_plugin::contract` (CC1 — one grammar).
- **Placement** — `Placement::for_executable` accepts
  `in_process|subprocess_confined|container|remote|component_model`;
  `in_process` admissibility = first-party registrar authority ∧
  `hh/` namespace (both — CF-141); `remote`/`container`/`component_model`
  admission-only at Stage 1 → `LocalityInadmissible`.
- **ADR-0262** records the decisions this ticket owns (crate home, manifest
  rides `ExtensionRecord{kind:plugin}.manifest`, policies ride
  `RegistryPolicy`, manifest `tier`/`depends_on` as top-level required
  members, layered-first precedence, range-grammar consolidation, member pin
  rules, `hh-hosting/1` absent-by-construction).
